professionalSummary.text: The candidate is a Revenue Management Data Scientist with experience in building room-demand forecasts and price-elasticity models.
professionalSummary.witness: Revenue management data scientist at Brightwater Hotels (42 mid-market hotels), March 2022 to present, building nightly room-demand forecasts and price-elasticity estimates by hotel and booking window.

experienceHighlights.text: The candidate presented pricing recommendations to general managers and the commercial director and recorded the decisions taken.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the monthly pricing recommendations at the commercial review attended by the commercial director and the regional general managers, and kept the action log showing which recommendations were adopted.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: The candidate maintained the data pipeline from the property management system.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Maintained the daily extract from the property management system into the warehouse, with row-count and late-arrival checks that alert the data engineering rota.

skills.text: The candidate evaluated pricing tests against control hotels.
skills.witness: Evaluated the 2023 weekend minimum-stay test against six matched control hotels using a difference-in-differences comparison over twelve weeks.
